title: cephalomanes atrovirens subsp. boryanum
intro: Cephalomanes atrovirens subsp. boryanum, commonly known as Bory's polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The health benefits of Cephalomanes atrovirens subsp. boryanum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory tract infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can help to relieve bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions.
